Title: Welcome to NH5MP
Text: Lobbies, races and voice chat now run over Steam. Leaderboards, World Challenges and eSports come from this server.

Title: Kyrie Irving to Join the Cup Series with Rick Ware Racing 51
Brief: NBA Star Kyrie Irving gets his first race with Rick Ware Racing in the No. 51!
Text: Kyrie, yes the real Kyrie Irving will make his first NASCAR Cup Series debut in the no.51 Wick Ware Racing car! He will have his very first start in the 2019 1000 Bulbs 500 at Talladega!

Title: Stephan Curry to Join Cup Series with Rick Ware Racing 52
Brief: NBA Star Stephan Curry gets his first race with Rick Ware Racing in the No. 52!
Text: Steph Curry will be in the 52 car for Rick Ware Racing! He said, "I'm ready to win my first race!" It is reported that he donated $1M to his car team to have a faster ride.
